recommendations.description: Audit AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION PA-required mapping and claims reprocessing against contractual standards in CA, IN, and AR, and defer authorization-denial enforcement changes until validation is completed for AMG SPECIALTY HOSPITAL CENTRAL INDIANA - MUNCIE and the affected DRGs.
evidence: AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION is flagged auth_or_mapping_shift in CA, IN, and AR.
All source groups are marked requires_validation_before_action.
IN includes AMG SPECIALTY HOSPITAL CENTRAL INDIANA - MUNCIE provider concentration.
Impacted diagnoses include bowel procedures, GI disorders, cellulitis, and cirrhosis.
peer_benchmarking: All listed payers show no documented auth status or appeals process.

recommendations.description: Implement a CA Medicaid inpatient policy audit for authorization-required ACUTE HOSPITAL stays in TANF Standard and ABD Non Dual: validate prior authorization and auth-to-claim matching, review denial enforcement, and verify contract-based reimbursement for Cellulitis without MCC, Major Small and Large Bowel Procedures with CC, Esophagitis, Gastroenteritis and Miscellaneous Digestive Disorders without MCC, Miscellaneous Disorders of Nutrition, Metabolism, and Fluids and Electrolytes without MCC, and Cirrhosis and Alcoholic Hepatitis with CC.
evidence: Pattern limited to CA Medicaid ACUTE HOSPITAL admissions with pa_required_code Y.
Largest pressure is TANF Standard; ABD Non Dual shows similar acute hospital pattern.
Variance concentrates in cellulitis, bowel procedures, GI disorders, metabolic disorders, and cirrhosis stays.
Spend increase reflects both admissions growth and higher paid per admit.

recommendations.description: Launch a CA inpatient focused review for DEHYDRATION, UNS SEVERE PROTEIN-CALORIE MLNUTRIT, ALCOHOLIC CIRRHOSIS LIVER W/ASCITES, ALCOHOLIC HEPATITIS WITH ASCITES, bowel surgery, and cellulitis cases at CHILDREN'S SPECIALIZED HOSPITAL and MERCY SAN JUAN MEDICAL CENTER to confirm prior authorization, review elective versus non-elective admissions, tighten discharge planning, and assess site-of-care or contract remediation.
evidence: CA inpatient spend increase is concentrated in liver, GI/metabolic, bowel surgery, and cellulitis.
DEHYDRATION is linked to CHILDREN'S SPECIALIZED HOSPITAL non-ER acute admissions.
ALCOHOLIC CIRRHOSIS LIVER W/ASCITES clustered at MERCY SAN JUAN MEDICAL CENTER ER admissions.
Source cards show pa_required_code Y across metabolic and liver admissions.
ALCOHOLIC HEPATITIS WITH ASCITES is flagged low_baseline_value case-mix validation.
peer_benchmarking: Humana: Criteria required with documented qualifying indication, including liver disease.
United Health: Conditional payment requires eligible diagnosis; one unit every 180 days; no separate reimbursement.

recommendations.description: Review ECU HEALTH MEDICAL CENTER for contract remediation and site-of-care action by auditing NC Medicaid TANF Standard and TANF Foster Care inpatient claims across ACUTE HOSPITAL and Not Mapped records, confirming authorization-to-claim matches and contract-compliant reimbursement.
evidence: ECU Not Mapped TANF Standard added about +$0.6M across 9 admissions.
Not Mapped ECU paid per admit increased about +$65.1K.
Major Small and Large Bowel Procedures with CC added 12 admissions.
TANF Foster Care acute admissions added about +$0.2M at ECU.
TANF Standard ACUTE HOSPITAL records were flagged auth-required.
peer_benchmarking: United Health documents bundled non-separately-payable code pairings, including restrictions with 64727.

recommendations.description: Initiate a targeted inpatient claims and case-level audit of the highest-cost UNATTRIBUTED, IA, IN, and OH admissions tied to Arkansas Children's Hospital, Iowa Methodist Medical Center, and AMG Specialty Hospital Central Indiana - Muncie, prioritizing Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with MCC, Other Multiple Significant Trauma with MCC, Gastrointestinal Obstruction with MCC, Wound Debridements for Injuries with MCC, and Stomach, Esophageal and Duodenal Procedures without CC/MCC to confirm attribution and verify interim and first claims are zeroed out to the final bill.
evidence: UNATTRIBUTED severe cases are led by pneumonia with MCC and trauma with MCC.
Arkansas Children's Hospital contains repeated outlier admissions for pneumonia and trauma.
Iowa Methodist Medical Center shows stomach malignancy surgery as a single-admission outlier.
AMG Specialty Hospital Central Indiana - Muncie has multiple single-admission outliers.
Pattern requires attribution cleanup and case-level review before broader action.
peer_benchmarking: Moda Health requires complete, signed, dated records and retained source documentation.
Premera Blue Cross requires readmission relationship and same-day transfer coding documentation.
Fidelis Care requires medical records for both stays and readmission relatedness.

recommendations.description: Perform a targeted MO and TX Medicaid inpatient claims and contract policy audit for TANF Standard and LTSS Non Dual CHILDRENS admissions in Miscellaneous Disorders of Nutrition, Metabolism, and Fluids and Electrolytes without MCC and MO TANF Standard ACUTE HOSPITAL admissions in Esophagitis, Gastroenteritis and Miscellaneous Digestive Disorders without MCC and Cirrhosis and Alcoholic Hepatitis with CC to validate prior authorization matching, denial enforcement, reimbursement methodology compliance, and site-of-care or contract remediation.
evidence: Esophagitis, Gastroenteritis and Miscellaneous Digestive Disorders without MCC drove MO ACUTE HOSPITAL growth.
Cirrhosis and Alcoholic Hepatitis with CC also drove MO ACUTE HOSPITAL growth.
Miscellaneous Disorders of Nutrition, Metabolism, and Fluids and Electrolytes without MCC concentrated in CHILDRENS.
TX CHILDRENS repeats across TANF Standard and LTSS Non Dual.
Pattern includes pa_required_code Y and N segments.
Admissions and avg paid per admit both increased.
peer_benchmarking: Molina requires listed ICD-10 diagnoses and compliant sequencing; manifestation and external cause codes cannot be primary.
Parkland requires underlying or toxic-agent codes first; manifestations and residuals cannot be primary.

recommendations.description: Review AR Medicaid LTSS Non Dual inpatient claims with pa_required_code=Y across CHILDRENS, ACUTE HOSPITAL, and Not Mapped, beginning with Arkansas Children's Hospital, to enforce authorization-to-claim matching, validate facility mapping, confirm claims process to contractual reimbursement terms, and tighten site-of-care routing.
evidence: CHILDRENS is the largest LTSS Non Dual driver in AR.
Arkansas Children's Hospital appears in drill context for CHILDRENS claims.
ACUTE HOSPITAL growth is admissions-driven for LTSS Non Dual.
Not Mapped carries unmapped_or_unknown_value and validation_needed.
All source cards show pa_required_code=Y and auth_dimension_present.
peer_benchmarking: Centene shows no DRG guidance; documented policy scope is limited to respiratory viral panel PCR medical necessity.

recommendations.description: Launch a focused episode policy audit for IN Family Care cases with Major Small and Large Bowel Procedures with CC that transition from ACUTE HOSPITAL to AMG SPECIALTY HOSPITAL CENTRAL INDIANA - MUNCIE LONG TERM CARE HOSPITAL, including auth-to-claim matching, alternate discharge review, and LTCH contractual payment validation.
evidence: Major Small and Large Bowel Procedures with CC drove acute hospital admission growth.
AMG Specialty Hospital Central Indiana - Muncie added LTCH admissions.
AMG LTCH stays showed higher paid per admit.
Both impacted claim sets required prior authorization.
